$comment: How this game is shipped: its site (web: its folder on the shared site, tiling-games.pages.dev/<path>/; the Cloudflare Pages project of its own, if it still has one; where it is played; and movedFrom, a project it left that now redirects to it — see scripts/lib/games.mjs), its landing-page card (description, appStore), the files its packaged bundle must carry (bundledAssets, checked by scripts/check-offline-assets.mjs), its desktop app (desktop, staged by scripts/stage-desktop.sh) and how many CI runners its e2e and unit tests are split over (ci; tests/unit/shard.ts is how the unit tests take their slice). The workflows list the games from these files (scripts/games.mjs). sharedVersion: its version is Hypersweeper's, bumped with it (scripts/bump_version.py). See docs/agents/new-game.md.
description: Cover the board, tile by tile: a drag-and-drop puzzle on the uniform and Laves tilings.
